mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real GDP growth exceeds 3% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate rises by > 0.5pp, but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 60% of the time over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production signals a supply shock or weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Industrial production declines by > 2% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive more than 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts decline by > 10% YoY, but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 60% of the time over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate increases by > 1% in 3 months, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive more than 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer prices signals rising inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI increases by > 0.5% MoM, but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 60% of the time over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Payroll employment increases by > 200k jobs per month, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real estate investment signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real estate investment declines by > 5% YoY, but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 60% of the time over the next 20 days.
